title: Bitdefender GravityZone Endpoint Compliance Posture
description: Endpoint compliance posture collected from Bitdefender GravityZone Control Center (artifacts/bitdefender.details.json). A value the collector could not read is null or absent, and the collector result artifact records why.
comment: Fields marked x-epack-level audit are present at audit and internal; fields marked internal are present only at internal.

collected_at_level.description: Collection level this artifact was produced at. Levels are cumulative: audit is a superset of trust, internal of audit.
collected_at_level.x-epack-summary: The detail level this artifact was collected at. It is trust, audit, or internal.

scope.description: What was in scope for the run
scope.x-epack-summary: What was in scope for this collection run.

total_managed_computers.description: Endpoints GravityZone reports with machineType 1 (a physical or virtual computer), with or without the GravityZone agent, under parent_group_id or the whole company. It includes the computers in the Active Directory folder, each endpoint ID once
total_managed_computers.x-epack-summary: Physical and virtual computers in the company or the configured group, including those synced from Active Directory. It includes computers without the GravityZone agent.
total_managed_computers.x-epack-method: Lists every endpoint in the company or the configured group and the groups below it, adds the endpoints in the Active Directory folder, and counts the distinct endpoint IDs with machineType 1.

compliance.description: Org-wide compliance across the computers in scope. A computer is compliant when it has the GravityZone agent, its assigned policy is applied, and its agent is not out of date.
compliance.x-epack-summary: Endpoint compliance across the computers in scope.

compliance_percentage.description: Percentage of computers in scope that are compliant, rounded to two decimal places
compliance_percentage.x-epack-summary: Share of computers in scope that are compliant. A computer counts when its GravityZone agent is up to date and its assigned policy is applied.
compliance_percentage.x-epack-method: Divides the compliant count by the computers in scope, as a percentage rounded to two decimal places.

compliant_count.description: Computers in scope that are compliant
compliant_count.x-epack-summary: Computers in scope that are compliant. A computer counts when its GravityZone agent is up to date and its assigned policy is applied.
compliant_count.x-epack-method: Counts the computers whose endpoint list row has isManaged and policy.applied true and productOutdated false.

non_compliant_count.description: Computers in scope that are not compliant
non_compliant_count.x-epack-summary: Computers in scope that are not compliant. This includes computers without the GravityZone agent.
non_compliant_count.x-epack-method: Subtracts the compliant count from the computers in scope.

endpoints.description: Per-computer inventory with the signals behind the compliance percentage
endpoints.x-epack-summary: One row per computer in scope, with the values behind the compliance percentage.

per_endpoint.description: One row per computer in scope, up to 20,000 rows, non-compliant rows first when the cap applies
per_endpoint.x-epack-summary: One row per computer in scope, up to 20,000 rows.

managed.description: True when the computer has the GravityZone agent (isManaged)
managed.x-epack-summary: Whether the computer has the GravityZone agent installed.

compliant.description: Whether the computer is compliant; null when GravityZone left out a field the answer needs
compliant.x-epack-summary: Whether the computer's GravityZone agent is up to date and its assigned policy is applied. It is null when the endpoint list is missing one of these values.

policy_applied.description: True when the assigned policy has reached the computer (policy.applied). Absent when GravityZone reports no policy, as for a computer without the agent.
policy_applied.x-epack-summary: Whether the assigned security policy has reached the computer.

product_outdated.description: True when the agent is missing one or more updates (productOutdated). Absent when GravityZone does not report it, as for a computer without the agent.
product_outdated.x-epack-summary: Whether the GravityZone agent is missing one or more updates.

last_scan_name.description: Name of the last successful scan
last_scan_name.x-epack-summary: Name of the computer's last successful scan.

last_scan_date.description: Date of the last successful scan
last_scan_date.x-epack-summary: When the computer's last successful scan ran.

truncated.description: True when rows past the 20,000 cap were dropped
truncated.x-epack-summary: Whether computers past the 20,000-row cap were left out of the rows. The counts still cover every computer.

truncated_dropped.x-epack-summary: Computers left out of the rows by the 20,000-row cap.

quarantine.description: Quarantined items from the Quarantine API's computers service
quarantine.x-epack-summary: Quarantined items on the company's computers.

total_count.description: Quarantined items across the whole company and every machine type, including items on endpoints outside the run's scope
total_count.x-epack-summary: Quarantined items across the whole company and every machine type. This includes endpoints outside the configured group.

per_computer.description: Quarantined items on computers in scope, up to 20,000 rows
per_computer.x-epack-summary: Quarantined items on computers in scope, up to 20,000 rows.

computer.description: Name of the computer the item was quarantined on
computer.x-epack-summary: Name of the computer the item was quarantined on.

action_status.x-epack-summary: GravityZone's raw action status code for the item. Each code's meaning is in Bitdefender's API reference.

file_name.description: Base name of the quarantined file
file_name.x-epack-summary: Base name of the quarantined file, without its directory.

file_path_hash.description: SHA-256 of the quarantined file's full path, which is never emitted
file_path_hash.x-epack-summary: SHA-256 of the quarantined file's full path. The path itself is never written.

truncated.description: True when rows past the 20,000 cap were dropped
truncated.x-epack-summary: Whether items past the 20,000-row cap were left out of the rows.

truncated_dropped.x-epack-summary: Quarantined items left out of the rows by the 20,000-row cap.

policies.description: Assigned policy and enabled protection modules per computer
policies.x-epack-summary: Each computer's assigned policy and enabled protection modules.

per_endpoint.description: One row per computer in scope
per_endpoint.x-epack-summary: One row per computer in scope.

policy_id.x-epack-summary: ID of the assigned GravityZone policy.

policy_name.x-epack-summary: Name of the assigned GravityZone security policy.

applied.description: True when the assigned policy has reached the computer
applied.x-epack-summary: Whether the assigned policy has reached the computer.

modules_enabled.description: Protection modules GravityZone reports as enabled on the computer, empty for a computer without the agent
modules_enabled.x-epack-summary: Protection modules enabled on the computer, such as antimalware and firewall. A computer without the GravityZone agent has none.

diagnostics.description: Permission problems and other non-fatal warnings, kept for readers that parse them. The collector result records the same problems by value.
diagnostics.x-epack-summary: Permission errors and other warnings from the run.

permission_errors.x-epack-summary: Sections left out because the API key lacks the GravityZone API they need.

warnings.x-epack-summary: Problems during the run that left out part of a section.
